drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thanks—attached is a streamlined mutual NDA markup. edits.text: PARTIES. This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (“Agreement”) is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures (each, a “Party” and together, the “Parties”).
edits.name: Parties

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE. The Parties wish to explore and evaluate a potential transaction and may disclose certain confidential and proprietary information in connection with that purpose.
edits.name: Purpose

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATION. The receiving Party shall keep Confidential Information strictly confidential and use it solely for the Purpose. The receiving Party shall protect disclosed information with at least a reasonable degree of care and shall not disclose it except to its Representatives who need to know for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than those hereunder.
edits.name: Confidentiality Obligation

edits.text: 3. TERM. This Agreement begins on the date of last signature and remains in effect for twenty-four (24) months; provided, however, that each Party’s obligation to protect Confidential Information disclosed during the term shall continue for three (3) years after disclosure, and trade secrets shall be protected for so long as they remain trade secrets under applicable law.
edits.name: Term

edits.text: 4. REMEDIES. The Parties acknowledge that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages may be an insufficient remedy, and that the non-breaching Party shall be entitled to seek injunctive or other equitable relief, in addition to any other remedies available at law or in equity.
edits.name: Remedies

edits.text: 5. EXCEPTIONS. Confidential Information does not include information that the receiving Party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes publicly available through no breach of this Agreement; (b) was already known to the receiving Party without restriction before disclosure; (c) is lawfully received from a third party without breach of any obligation; or (d) was independently developed without use of the disclosing Party’s Confidential Information.
edits.name: Exceptions

edits.text: 6. REQUIRED DISCLOSURE. If the receiving Party is required by law, regulation, or court order to disclose any Confidential Information, it may do so provided it gives prompt prior notice to the disclosing Party (to the extent legally permitted) and reasonably cooperates in seeking confidential treatment or a protective order.
edits.name: Required Disclosure

edits.text: 7. RETURN/DESTRUCTION. Upon written request, each receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy Confidential Information in its possession or control, except for one archival copy retained solely for legal, compliance, or internal recordkeeping purposes, subject to continuing confidentiality obligations.
edits.name: Return/Destruction
